section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews literature linking BMI and body image to women's sexual health, noting inconsistent findings for BMI and stronger evidence for appearance dissatisfaction predicting poorer sexual outcomes. It highlights that only two studies to date have examined body appreciation specifically (Satinsky et al., 2012; van den Brink et al., 2016) with mixed results, and that much existing work has focused on student samples rather than age-diverse samples.
section_summary.evidence_source: 'To date, only two studies have examined the relationship between body appreciation, sexual function, and sexual satisfaction (Satinsky et al., 2012; van den Brink, Smeets, Hessen, & Woertman, 2016).' Also: 'most of the existing research focusing on body image and sexual health has focused primarily on student samples; an investigation of sexuality and body image with an age-diverse sample is overdue.'
